summary:
Greetings.....
Arogya Drishti is a smart health monitoring system Designed to provide a real time psychological tracking, predictive insights and automated medical alerts 
This is for the Deep space mission of astronauts  
Our solution addresses this challenge by continuously analyzing astronauts and detect their health anomalies 
Arogya Drishti transforms complex health metrics into clear actionable insights and triggers instant alerts so the crew members can take preventive actions  
By enabling autonomous proactive healthcare in orbit Arogya Drishti enhances astronauts safety and mission success 
Thanking You..........

Greetings.....

ArogyaDrishti is an interactive web health app which displays a clearer guidance, Visual feedback, Wellness recommendation and interaction of trust between User and App.

Meaning : Arogya means Health and Drishti means Focused Gaze

We used some of the tools for building this app those are:

Python

Visual Studio Code

Streamlit

Github

Factors we considered in our app:

Simplicity, Accessibility, User Safety, Technologically Advanced
